sessions.title: A Reviewing the work of academics
sessions.description_vi: Xem xét các trích đoạn từ các bài đánh giá trong các tạp chí học thuật.
sessions.value:
# Academic writing 1: giving opinions

## A Reviewing the work of academics

Look at these extracts from reviews in academic journals.

In 1998, Lucas Georgescu published the results of his **groundbreaking research** on genetics. His latest paper also makes a **significant contribution** to the field. He sets out some **powerful arguments** which will **shape our thinking** for years to come.

In this latest book, Marina Kass **gives an account of** Karl Marx’s philosophy and **provides evidence** to **support the claim** that Garpov seriously misinterpreted Marx. In addition, the book offers a **concise summary** of the present state of Marxist philosophy.

1 influence
2 short and clear

Partridge strenuously defends her theory, which has **come under attack** recently in several journals. She argues that the Prime Minister played a **central role** in the political crisis of 1811, and **goes into great detail** to **support her argument**.

Nathan Peel attempts to **establish a connection** between mobile phone use and physical damage to users’ brains, but he does not offer **irrefutable proof** and the statistics do not show any **significant trends**.

3 absolute proof, impossible to prove wrong

sessions.title: B Stating things strongly and less strongly
sessions.description_vi: Các câu dưới đây diễn đạt ý kiến, mạnh mẽ hoặc ít mạnh mẽ hơn.
sessions.value:
## B Stating things strongly and less strongly

The sentences below express opinions, either strongly or less strongly.

### Strong expressions of opinion

The invention of the steam engine was the **key factor** in the birth of the industrial revolution.
The events of 1954 are a **perfect example** of how political leaders make misjudgements that have serious long-term effects.
This is a **clear illustration** of the importance of a strong monetary policy.

### Less strong expressions of opinion

The figures offer a **tentative explanation** of the causes of acid rain pollution. [an explanation given by someone who is not totally certain that it is the correct explanation]
The statistics **broadly support** the view that the economy is heading towards recession.

### Other general academic collocations

There is a **strong tendency** in the work of some linguists to suggest that spoken language is inferior to written language.
We must first **gather evidence**, then **carry out** a detailed study of all the factors that **play a part** in social conditioning.
You cannot expect your claim to be accepted if you cannot offer **supporting evidence**.
Simon Hart **challenges the theory** of social change put forward by Professor Kemp.
It is important in academic writing always to **acknowledge your sources**. If you fail to do this, you will commit plagiarism. [use another person’s idea or a part of their work and pretend that it is your own]

> **Common mistakes**
>
> We do research or **carry out** research, NOT make research.
> Someone **puts forward a theory** or **proposes a theory**, NOT gives a theory.

image.value: A laboratory setting with a scientist looking at a glowing DNA helix on a screen, representing innovative discovery.

senses.definition_vi: Nghiên cứu mang tính đột phá, mở ra những hướng đi mới hoặc thay đổi hoàn toàn hiểu biết hiện tại.
examples: His groundbreaking research on stem cells won him international acclaim.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Sử dụng để nhấn mạnh tính mới mẻ và quan trọng của một công trình nghiên cứu.

use_prompts.question: Should governments spend more money on scientific work that completely changes our understanding of the world?
Which medical discoveries do you think have improved people's lives the most in recent decades?
Should private technology companies be allowed to keep the results of important studies secret?

dictation.text: Her groundbreaking research changed how doctors treat cancer.

paraphrase.source: The scientist's studies completely changed what we know about the human brain.
paraphrase.model: The scientist's groundbreaking research transformed our understanding of the human brain.

paraphrase.source: Many people believe that studies which open up whole new areas of science deserve more funding.
paraphrase.model: Many people believe that groundbreaking research deserves more funding.

image.value: A puzzle where one piece is being slotted in, labeled 'Contribution', completing a larger picture.

senses.definition_vi: Đóng góp một phần quan trọng hoặc đáng kể vào một lĩnh vực hay mục tiêu nào đó.
examples: This study makes a significant contribution to our understanding of ancient civilizations.
senses.grammar_patterns: make a significant contribution to something
senses.usage_notes_vi: Cấu trúc trang trọng, thường dùng trong nhận xét học thuật hoặc báo cáo công việc.

use_prompts.question: In what ways do volunteers help their local communities?
How important is tourism to the economy of your country?
Can individuals really help to reduce pollution, or is it the government's job?

dictation.text: Tourism makes a significant contribution to the local economy.

paraphrase.source: Recycling helps a great deal in reducing the amount of waste we produce.
paraphrase.model: Recycling makes a significant contribution to reducing the amount of waste we produce.

paraphrase.source: Each player on the team adds a lot to its success.
paraphrase.model: Each player makes a significant contribution to the team's success.

image.value: A person standing at a podium presenting clear, strong bullet points on a large screen.

senses.definition_vi: Trình bày hoặc đưa ra những lập luận sắc bén, có sức thuyết phục cao.
examples: The author sets out powerful arguments in favor of renewable energy.
senses.grammar_patterns: set out powerful arguments for/against something
senses.usage_notes_vi: 'Set out' mang nghĩa là trình bày một cách có hệ thống và chi tiết.

use_prompts.question: What makes a newspaper opinion article persuasive to readers?
What skills do students need to write a good argumentative essay?
How can campaigners persuade governments to invest more in renewable energy?

dictation.text: The report sets out powerful arguments for cleaner public transport.

paraphrase.source: In her book, the writer gives very convincing reasons for banning fast food advertising.
paraphrase.model: In her book, the writer sets out powerful arguments for banning fast food advertising.

paraphrase.source: The essay presents strong reasons why university education should be free.
paraphrase.model: The essay sets out powerful arguments for free university education.

image.value: Two hands molding a clay brain, symbolizing the influence of ideas on the mind.

senses.definition_vi: Định hình cách chúng ta suy nghĩ hoặc nhìn nhận về một vấn đề.
examples: Social media has begun to shape our thinking about privacy and personal space.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để nói về những yếu tố có sức ảnh hưởng lớn đến tư duy hoặc quan điểm.

use_prompts.question: How much influence does advertising have on the way people see the world?
Which teachers or books have influenced your views the most?
How has social media changed the way young people form their opinions?

dictation.text: The books we read as children shape our thinking.

paraphrase.source: The news we watch every day strongly influences the way we see the world.
paraphrase.model: The news we watch every day helps to shape our thinking about the world.

paraphrase.source: Our parents have a big influence on how we view money.
paraphrase.model: Our parents shape our thinking about money.

image.value: A book open at a page showing a narrative description of an event.

senses.definition_vi: Thuật lại, giải thích hoặc cung cấp thông tin chi tiết về một sự việc.
examples: The report gives an account of the financial crisis and its causes.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Tương đương với 'describe' nhưng mang tính trang trọng và chi tiết hơn.

use_prompts.question: What should a good news report include when it describes a major event?
Why is it useful for students to study the history of their own country?
What do you usually tell your friends when you come back from a trip?

dictation.text: The museum guide gives an account of the city's history.

paraphrase.source: The book describes in detail what life was like during the war.
paraphrase.model: The book gives an account of life during the war.

paraphrase.source: In her statement, the witness describes exactly what happened on the night of the accident.
paraphrase.model: In her statement, the witness gives an account of what happened on the night of the accident.

item_6.word: provides evidence to support the claim

image.value: A magnifying glass focusing on a fingerprint on a document, suggesting forensic proof.

senses.definition_vi: Cung cấp bằng chứng để xác thực hoặc hỗ trợ cho một khẳng định.
examples: The archaeologist provides evidence to support the claim that the site was once a palace.
senses.grammar_patterns: provide evidence to support the claim that [clause]
senses.usage_notes_vi: Cụm từ tiêu chuẩn trong viết luận học thuật để chứng minh luận điểm.

use_prompts.question: How can scientists prove that a new medicine is safe to use?
Why should journalists check their facts before they publish a story?
What makes an argument in an academic essay convincing?

dictation.target: provides evidence to support the claim
dictation.text: This new data provides evidence to support the claim.

paraphrase.target: provides evidence to support the claim
paraphrase.source: The research shows that the idea that exercise improves mood is probably true.
paraphrase.model: The research provides evidence to support the claim that exercise improves mood.

paraphrase.target: provides evidence to support the claim
paraphrase.source: Recent sales data backs up the company's statement that online shopping is growing.
paraphrase.model: Recent sales data provides evidence to support the claim that online shopping is growing.

image.value: A long text being condensed into a small sticky note with three bullet points.

senses.definition_vi: Bản tóm tắt ngắn gọn và súc tích, lược bỏ những chi tiết không cần thiết.
examples: The lecturer gave a concise summary of the entire semester's work in ten minutes.
senses.usage_notes_vi: 'Concise' nhấn mạnh việc tiết kiệm từ ngữ nhưng vẫn đủ ý.

use_prompts.question: What makes a presentation at work effective?
Why do many people prefer short news updates to long articles?
How can students prepare effectively for their exams?

dictation.text: Please write a concise summary of the main points.

paraphrase.source: At the end of the meeting, the manager listed the key decisions in a few clear words.
paraphrase.model: At the end of the meeting, the manager gave a concise summary of the key decisions.

paraphrase.source: The app gives readers a short, clear version of each news story.
paraphrase.model: The app gives readers a concise summary of each news story.

image.value: A person with a determined expression blocking a path, symbolizing defense of a position.

senses.definition_vi: Bảo vệ một quan điểm, lý thuyết hay hành động một cách quyết liệt, mạnh mẽ.
examples: The minister strenuously defends his decision to increase taxes.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng khi đối mặt với sự phản đối hoặc chỉ trích dữ dội.

use_prompts.question: How should politicians respond when the public criticises their decisions?
Should employees always support their company's policies in public?
Why do some celebrities fight so hard to protect their reputation?

dictation.text: The mayor strenuously defends the new parking rules.

paraphrase.source: The minister argues very strongly and firmly that his tax plan is fair.
paraphrase.model: The minister strenuously defends his tax plan as fair.

paraphrase.source: The coach protects his players from criticism with great energy.
paraphrase.model: The coach strenuously defends his players against criticism.

image.value: A castle being surrounded by storm clouds and lightning, representing being under pressure.

senses.definition_vi: Bị tấn công hoặc bị chỉ trích nặng nề.
examples: The company's environmental record has come under attack from activists.
senses.grammar_patterns: come under attack for something/from somebody
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong ngữ cảnh bị phê phán công khai hoặc dữ dội.

use_prompts.question: Why are large oil companies so often criticised by environmental groups?
Why are some newspapers criticised for the way they report the news?
Why has the traditional exam system been criticised in recent years?

dictation.text: The new law has come under attack from teachers.

paraphrase.source: The government's housing policy has been strongly criticised by many experts.
paraphrase.model: The government's housing policy has come under attack from many experts.

paraphrase.source: Fast food companies are often criticised for selling unhealthy meals to children.
paraphrase.model: Fast food companies often come under attack for selling unhealthy meals to children.

image.value: A conductor leading an orchestra, standing in the middle of all performers.

senses.definition_vi: Đóng vai trò trung tâm, chủ chốt trong một sự kiện hoặc quá trình.
examples: The community center played a central role in organizing the relief effort.
senses.grammar_patterns: play a central role in something
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng không thể thiếu của một cá nhân hoặc tổ chức.

use_prompts.question: Who had the biggest influence on you when you were growing up?
How important was the internet in helping people during the pandemic?
Which groups in society helped most after recent natural disasters?

dictation.text: My grandmother played a central role in raising me.

paraphrase.source: Volunteers were the most important part of the rescue effort.
paraphrase.model: Volunteers played a central role in the rescue effort.

paraphrase.source: Mobile phones were extremely important in organising the protests.
paraphrase.model: Mobile phones played a central role in organising the protests.

image.value: A magnifying glass over a complex mechanical drawing.

senses.definition_vi: Đi sâu vào chi tiết, trình bày một cách tỉ mỉ và cặn kẽ.
examples: The manual goes into great detail about how to assemble the furniture.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng khi nói về một bản báo cáo, cuốn sách hoặc bài thuyết trình rất kỹ lưỡng.

use_prompts.question: Do you prefer news articles that explain events thoroughly, or just short headlines?
What makes a textbook useful for students?
What information should a good travel guidebook include?

dictation.text: The guidebook goes into great detail about local food.

paraphrase.source: The documentary explains every step of the building process very thoroughly.
paraphrase.model: The documentary goes into great detail about every step of the building process.

paraphrase.source: The teacher explains the grammar rules very fully.
paraphrase.model: The teacher goes into great detail about the grammar rules.

image.value: Two electrical wires being joined together, creating a spark of contact.

senses.definition_vi: Thiết lập hoặc chứng minh được sự liên hệ giữa các sự vật, hiện tượng.
examples: The police are trying to establish a connection between the two robberies.
senses.grammar_patterns: establish a connection between A and B
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong nghiên cứu khoa học hoặc điều tra tội phạm.

use_prompts.question: How can scientists show that diet causes certain diseases?
Why is it important for teachers to build good relationships with their students?
How can online businesses build trust with new customers?

dictation.text: Researchers tried to establish a connection between diet and sleep.

paraphrase.source: Scientists want to find out whether pollution is linked to asthma.
paraphrase.model: Scientists want to establish a connection between pollution and asthma.

paraphrase.source: A good speaker quickly builds a bond with the audience.
paraphrase.model: A good speaker quickly manages to establish a connection with the audience.

image.value: A golden seal or certificate with a prominent red stamp of authenticity.

senses.definition_vi: Bằng chứng thép, bằng chứng không thể chối cãi hay bác bỏ được.
examples: CCTV footage provided irrefutable proof of his innocence.
senses.usage_notes_vi: 'Irrefutable' là từ mạnh, chỉ những thứ hoàn toàn chính xác và hiển nhiên.

use_prompts.question: Is there enough scientific evidence that humans are causing climate change?
Should people only be found guilty when the evidence is completely certain?
Can video recordings still be trusted as evidence in court nowadays?

dictation.text: The video was irrefutable proof that he was innocent.

paraphrase.source: The DNA test showed beyond any doubt that he was the father.
paraphrase.model: The DNA test was irrefutable proof that he was the father.

paraphrase.source: Satellite images show without question that the ice is melting.
paraphrase.model: Satellite images give irrefutable proof that the ice is melting.

image.value: A line graph showing a clear, steady upward movement over several years.

senses.definition_vi: Các xu hướng quan trọng hoặc đáng chú ý đang diễn ra.
examples: Economists have noted several significant trends in the global job market.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng trong phân tích dữ liệu để chỉ những thay đổi có tầm ảnh hưởng.

use_prompts.question: How has the job market in your country changed in recent years?
What are the most important changes in how people use technology today?
How have people's shopping habits changed over the last decade?

dictation.text: The report shows several significant trends in online shopping.

paraphrase.source: The data shows some important patterns of change in how young people travel.
paraphrase.model: The data shows some significant trends in how young people travel.

paraphrase.source: Experts have noticed several major changes over time in eating habits.
paraphrase.model: Experts have noticed several significant trends in eating habits.

image.value: A large golden key lying next to a locked door labeled 'Success'.

senses.definition_vi: Yếu tố then chốt, nhân tố quan trọng nhất dẫn đến một kết quả.
examples: Motivation is often the key factor in learning a new language.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ nguyên nhân chính hoặc điều kiện tiên quyết.

use_prompts.question: What is the most important thing for success in learning a language?
What makes people stay in the same job for a long time?
What is the main reason why some people live longer than others?

dictation.text: Hard work is the key factor in success.

paraphrase.source: Price is the most important thing people consider when they buy a car.
paraphrase.model: Price is the key factor when people buy a car.

paraphrase.source: Good sleep is one of the main things that affect students' exam results.
paraphrase.model: Good sleep is a key factor in students' exam results.

image.value: A flawlessly shaped diamond in a display case, representing perfection.

senses.definition_vi: Ví dụ điển hình, minh chứng hoàn hảo cho một quy luật hay hiện tượng.
examples: This building is a perfect example of Gothic architecture.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng khi một sự vật hội tụ đầy đủ các đặc điểm tiêu biểu nhất của một nhóm.

use_prompts.question: Which building in your city best represents its history?
Can you name a country that is doing very well at protecting nature?
Who in your family is a good role model?

dictation.text: This old temple is a perfect example of local architecture.

paraphrase.source: Singapore shows extremely well how a city can be both green and modern.
paraphrase.model: Singapore is a perfect example of how a city can be both green and modern.

paraphrase.source: My father shows exactly what a hard-working person looks like.
paraphrase.model: My father is a perfect example of a hard-working person.

image.value: A bright, clear infographic with icons and arrows explaining a process.

senses.definition_vi: Sự minh họa rõ ràng, giúp người khác dễ dàng hình dung hoặc hiểu vấn đề.
examples: The chart provides a clear illustration of how the company's profits have grown.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Có thể dùng cho cả hình ảnh trực quan hoặc một ví dụ bằng lời nói.

use_prompts.question: What evidence shows that climate change is already happening?
Why do teachers use charts and pictures in their lessons?
What shows most obviously the gap between rich and poor in cities?

dictation.text: This graph is a clear illustration of rising prices.

paraphrase.source: The floods last year showed very clearly how dangerous climate change can be.
paraphrase.model: The floods last year were a clear illustration of how dangerous climate change can be.

paraphrase.source: The long queues at the hospital clearly showed how few doctors there are.
paraphrase.model: The long queues at the hospital were a clear illustration of the shortage of doctors.

image.value: A person looking at a puzzle with a hesitant expression, holding one piece.

senses.definition_vi: Lời giải thích mang tính tạm thời, chưa chắc chắn, cần được kiểm chứng thêm.
examples: The doctors offered a tentative explanation for the patient's sudden recovery.
senses.usage_notes_vi: 'Tentative' ám chỉ sự dè dặt, không khẳng định 100%.

use_prompts.question: How should doctors talk to patients when they are not sure what is wrong?
Why do scientists often disagree about the causes of unusual weather?
How should a manager explain a problem before all the facts are known?

dictation.text: The scientist offered a tentative explanation for the strange results.

paraphrase.source: The police suggested a possible reason for the accident, but they were not certain.
paraphrase.model: The police offered a tentative explanation for the accident.

paraphrase.source: Researchers have an early, uncertain theory about why the birds disappeared.
paraphrase.model: Researchers have a tentative explanation for why the birds disappeared.

image.value: A group of people raising their hands in a meeting, showing general agreement.

senses.definition_vi: Ủng hộ một cách rộng rãi hoặc nhìn chung là đồng tình (dù có thể còn vài chi tiết nhỏ chưa khớp).
examples: Most scientists broadly support the theory that human activity causes climate change.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ sự đồng thuận chung của số đông.

use_prompts.question: Do most people in your country agree with the government's plans for public transport?
How do people in your country feel about banning plastic bags?
Do employees usually agree with changes such as working from home?

dictation.text: Most parents broadly support the new school rules.

paraphrase.source: Most residents generally agree with the plan to build a new park.
paraphrase.model: Most residents broadly support the plan to build a new park.

paraphrase.source: On the whole, teachers are in favour of shorter school holidays.
paraphrase.model: Teachers broadly support shorter school holidays.

image.value: A magnet pulling several metal objects toward it, showing a powerful lean.

senses.definition_vi: Xu hướng mạnh mẽ, khả năng cao là một việc gì đó sẽ xảy ra hoặc ai đó sẽ hành động như vậy.
examples: There is a strong tendency for history to repeat itself in this region.
senses.grammar_patterns: a strong tendency to do something / for something to happen
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ một thói quen hoặc một quy luật lặp đi lặp lại.

use_prompts.question: Why do young people often copy the behaviour of celebrities?
Why do people often buy things they do not really need?
Why do people check their phones so often?

dictation.text: Teenagers have a strong tendency to follow their friends.

paraphrase.source: People very often spend more money when they shop online.
paraphrase.model: People have a strong tendency to spend more money when they shop online.

paraphrase.source: Children usually copy what their parents do.
paraphrase.model: Children have a strong tendency to copy their parents.

image.value: A detective placing a small object into a plastic evidence bag.

senses.definition_vi: Thu thập bằng chứng, dữ liệu để chứng minh một điều gì đó.
examples: The legal team spent months trying to gather evidence against the corporation.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong bối cảnh pháp lý, cảnh sát hoặc nghiên cứu khoa học.

use_prompts.question: How can the police improve the way they solve crimes?
How should students research a topic for an essay?
How do scientists find out whether a species is in danger?

dictation.text: The police need to gather evidence before they arrest anyone.

paraphrase.source: Detectives spent weeks collecting facts and information about the robbery.
paraphrase.model: Detectives spent weeks trying to gather evidence about the robbery.

paraphrase.source: Scientists collect data to find out if the river is polluted.
paraphrase.model: Scientists gather evidence to find out if the river is polluted.

image.value: Researchers in white coats working in a lab with test tubes and clipboards.

senses.definition_vi: Tiến hành, thực hiện một cuộc nghiên cứu hoặc khảo sát.
examples: The university is planning to carry out a study on the effects of sleep deprivation.
